items.title: Charles "Creole Charlie" Levy Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: because Bro was with us at the, uh, Entertainer's Cafe.

ctx.x: Did you play Heron, Illinois? Yes. Yes, played Heron, Illinois with Jelly. Well, this is a band that we never found anybody who played Heron, Illinois with Jelly, and yet there's records that he worked for MCA. Yes, yes. Now, you said Barnes. Do you remember anybody else?

Well, the Barnes, I can't remember who else. Maybe, what's that bass player from New Orleans? John and Lindsey, I think. John. I think John and Lindsey was playing bass, because I don't think Bro was playing bass, because Bro was with us at the, uh, Entertainer's Cafe. Oh, yeah, Bro was the first one, when I, uh, we had some piece, and Bro was playing a, uh, walking bass, and that was the first time that, uh, I mean, the first night that Bro came on the job, and I was playing this violin, I heard all this bass,…
Johnny Lindsay also played trombone. He didn't play trombone in the band.
